title: FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon Lead Lexology Index Consulting Experts List for Eleventh Consecutive Year
summary: Recognition Underscores FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon’s Global Expertise in Construction Advisory, Disputes, Digital Forensics, E-discovery, Forensic Accounting and Investigations WASHINGTON, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FTI Consulting, Inc.
body_markdown:
**Recognition Underscores FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon’s Global Expertise in Construction Advisory, Disputes, Digital Forensics, E-discovery, Forensic Accounting and Investigations**


WASHINGTON, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN) today announced that the firm and its Compass Lexecon subsidiary led the *Lexology Index Consulting Experts* list for the eleventh consecutive year, with 127 professionals recognized globally.


The list identifies leading consulting experts through an independent research process that combines qualitative market feedback with quantitative analysis of relevant data points, including recommendations from corporate counsel, clients, law firms and other market participants. Professionals from FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon were selected based on the breadth of expertise across construction advisory, E-discovery, digital forensics, financial advisory and valuation and forensic accounting.


Several FTI Consulting and Compass Lexecon professionals were also named Global Elite Thought Leaders, a distinction for experts considered in the top 5% of practitioners worldwide. **About FTI Consulting**
FTI Consulting, Inc. is a leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation, with more than 8,100 employees located in 32 countries and territories as of June 30, 2026. In certain jurisdictions, FTI Consulting’s services are provided through distinct legal entities that are separately capitalized and independently managed. The Company generated $3.8 billion in revenues during fiscal year 2025. More information can be found at[https://www.fticonsulting.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ooC_gy6lcvE6KjbWoZKJzXFMBG4Ia3WlOeujGUPAK1dQ3h_pqF9mI86PCYNKarXPUhLIARM55II4WSQoOJAmpwwuWwgivhnoahtaLFwtkHsppz3qpnIjAaNEjZ9jgRKI) .


**About Compass Lexecon**
Compass Lexecon is internationally recognized as a leading economic consulting firm with preeminent competition, finance, intellectual property, international arbitration, and energy practices. With more than 600 professionals in 23 offices around the world, Compass Lexecon offers a global perspective on economic matters. For the past two decades, Compass Lexecon has been ranked as one of the leading antitrust economics firms in the world by the Global Competition Review.
